title: [TODO AR] Delete Your Account — Abjad Kids
intro: [TODO AR] If you'd like to delete your Abjad Kids account and associated data, you can request this at any time.
section1Content: [TODO AR] Send an email to abjedkids@gmail.com with the subject line "Account Deletion Request," including:
section1List1Item1: [TODO AR] The email address associated with your account (the one you used to sign in)
section1List1Item2: [TODO AR] Confirmation that you are the parent/guardian who created the account
section1Outro: [TODO AR] We will verify the request and process it within 7 business days of receiving it.
section2Content: [TODO AR] When you request account deletion, we delete:
section2List1Item1: [TODO AR] Your account and sign-in information
section2List1Item2: [TODO AR] Your child's name and age
section2List1Item3: [TODO AR] Your child's learning progress data
section2List1Item4: [TODO AR] Your subscription and payment status records
section3Content: [TODO AR] Some information may be retained for a limited period after deletion where required for legal, accounting, or fraud-prevention purposes — for example:
section3List1Item1: [TODO AR] Records of completed transactions, which we may be required to retain for a limited period for tax and accounting purposes
section3Outro: [TODO AR] Any retained information is kept only as long as legally required and is not used for any other purpose.
section4Content: [TODO AR] If you have any questions about this process or about how your data is handled more generally, see our Privacy Policy or contact us at abjedkids@gmail.com.
